# Asset manifest (all original, generated by tools/*.py — rerun `cd tools && python3 gen_player.py && python3 gen_enemies.py && python3 gen_world.py && python3 gen_cover.py`)

Load spritesheets with `this.load.spritesheet(key, path, {frameWidth, frameHeight})`. Frame index = row * columns + col. Unused cells in a row are transparent.

## sprites/
| File | Sheet px | Frame | Cols | Rows (name: frames → frame indices) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| sprites/player.png | 192x224 | 32x32 | 6 | idle:4 (0-3), run:6 (6-11), jump:2 (12-13), fall:2 (18-19), roll:5 (24-28), attack:5 (30-34), shoot:3 (36-38). Faces RIGHT; flipX for left. Feet at y≈30. |
| sprites/enemy_hollow.png | 128x96 | 32x32 | 4 | walk:4 (0-3), attack:4 (4-7), death:4 (8-11) |
| sprites/enemy_wraith.png | 128x64 | 32x32 | 4 | float:4 (0-3), cast:4 (4-7) — frozen stage flyer |
| sprites/enemy_cinderimp.png | 128x64 | 32x32 | 4 | hop:4 (0-3), burst:4 (4-7) — burning stage hopper |
| sprites/boss_frostwarden.png | 256x192 | 64x64 | 4 | idle:4 (0-3), slam:4 (4-7), charge:4 (8-11, ember palette = phase 2/3) |
| sprites/bonfire.png | 192x32 | 32x32 | 6 | burn:6 (0-5), loop at 8 fps |

## tiles/ (16x16 tiles, 8 cols x 2 rows, 128x32 each): tiles_stone.png, tiles_frozen.png, tiles_burning.png
Index map (same for all three): 0 fill, 1 ground top, 2 left wall edge, 3 right wall edge, 4 brick, 5 pillar, 6 one-way platform (top 5px), 7 gothic window, 8 hazard spikes (stone)/icicles (frozen)/flames (burning), 9 arch, 10 rubble deco, 11 hanging deco (moss/icicles/embers), 12-13 fill variants, 14 ground top variant, 15 brick variant.
Collide: 0-5,12-15. One-way: 6. Hazard: 8. Decor (no collide): 7,9,10,11.

## bg/ (320x180 each, parallax). For each stage k in {stone, frozen, burning}:
bg_k_far.png (scrollFactor 0.1, opaque sky), bg_k_mid.png (0.35, spires), bg_k_near.png (0.6, arches/particles). Use tileSprite and set tilePositionX = cam.scrollX*factor.

## ui/
bar_hp.png, bar_fp.png, bar_stamina.png (64x6 fills; crop width for value), bar_frame.png (64x6 gold frame), souls_icon.png (12x12), flask_icon.png (12x12).

## cover.png — 320x180 title art "ASHEN VIGIL".
## audio/ — see audio/CREDITS.md (10 WAV SFX, 22.05 kHz mono).
